basic_profile.bio: Hailing from Houston, I'm a tech enthusiast with a penchant for gaming and building custom PCs. By day, I work as a systems analyst, and by night, I dive into the world of esports, cheering for the Houston Outlaws. My interests also extend to strategy games like Victoria 3, where I can lose myself for hours. I'm a firm believer in optimizing both hardware and software for the best user experience. Married to my college sweetheart, we bond over a shared love of technology. Typically online during late evenings and weekends.

behavioral_pattern.knowledge_background: With a degree in Information Technology, I have honed my skills through years of hands-on experience and self-guided learning. My expertise lies in computer hardware, from assembling rigs to optimizing performance. Regularly follow tech blogs and forums to stay updated with the latest trends.
